teams.heading: Jake White tips Fiji as a 'massive force' for 2027 World Cup
teams.body: Jake White is already talking up Fiji's World Cup chances. After the 34-28 win over Japan in Tokyo, he said that if he can get "the best 33 players together" for the 2027 tournament in Australia, Fiji "can be a massive force". White named no Europe-based players for that game and handed out four new caps, and his overseas contingent will be available for the France, Ireland and Italy tests.

lead.why: It is the freshest item in the pack and gives a new angle on White's World Cup ambitions, not the appointment or the Japan result already covered.

teams.heading: Fin Smith withdrawn with calf injury as Charlie Atkinson joins England squad
teams.body: England's fly-half problem arrives ahead of the Nations Championship opener against Australia. Fin Smith, who started at 10 in all three July Tests, has damaged a calf and pulled out of the 36-man training squad, with Gloucester's Charlie Atkinson drafted in as cover. Borthwick also has Marcus Smith and George Ford as specialist 10s, but England's management say they remain hopeful Smith will be back in time, and an official update is due on Tuesday.

lead.why: A fresh injury and cover call-up that goes straight to England's fly-half plans before the Australia opener.

teams.heading: Galthié reshuffles France squad as Brau-Boirie, Hastoy and Gazzotti withdraw
teams.body: Fabien Galthié has been forced into a late reshuffle of his Nations Championship squad, with Fabien Brau-Boirie, Antoine Hastoy and Marko Gazzotti all ruled out by injuries picked up in Top 14 action. Nicolas Depoortere, Anthony Jelonch and uncapped Louis Le Brun are the replacements, adding to a squad already missing Matthieu Jalibert, Thomas Ramos and Julien Marchand. The campaign opens against Fiji before the Springboks and Argentina.

lead.why: A fresh squad shake-up with multiple injury withdrawals is new today, while the Cros and Ward items have already been covered.

teams.heading: Ireland's Tadhg Furlong cited over alleged groin grab against Munster
teams.body: Tadhg Furlong has been cited over an alleged groin grab on Munster back row Gavin Coombes in Leinster's URC win at the Aviva Stadium on Saturday, a case with direct consequences for Ireland's November plans. The TMO found no video evidence at the time. The URC says disciplinary arrangements are in progress. If found guilty, the 33-year-old would be in danger of missing Ireland's matches with Argentina, Fiji and South Africa in Dublin, as well as the finals weekend in London.

lead.why: A new disciplinary case against a named Ireland international that could reach the November Test window.

teams.heading: Tommaso Menoncello suffers shoulder sprain, likely to miss autumn Tests
teams.body: Menoncello went off in the 43rd minute of Toulouse's 43-40 Champions Cup win over Exeter Chiefs with a sprained left shoulder, expected to keep him out for several weeks and likely to rule him out of Italy's autumn Tests. It is another setback for the 24-year-old, who earlier this season was also hurt against La Rochelle. Gonzalo Quesada must now plan for South Africa, Argentina and Fiji without him.

lead.why: A key-player injury with a direct bearing on Italy's autumn Tests, and it has not yet been covered in the previous editions.

teams.heading: Ollie Leatherbarrow, uncapped Newcastle back-rower, named in Townsend's 37-man squad
teams.body: Ollie Leatherbarrow is the only uncapped name in Gregor Townsend's 37-man squad for the November Nations Championship Tests, the Newcastle Red Bulls back-rower having qualified through his grandmother from Perth. The 24-year-old, who has 11 Scotland U20 caps, is the most notable inclusion in an otherwise familiar group. Jamie Ritchie, Darcy Graham and Duhan van der Merwe are back after injury, and Huw Jones returns after missing the July tour. Grant Gilchrist is absent, and Hector Patterson has missed out.

lead.why: A new squad selection with an uncapped back-rower in the 37-man group is the story fans will be discussing, and it is covered by multiple outlets.

teams.heading: Steve Tandy's camp takes 24 Welsh players out of URC round five
teams.body: Steve Tandy's Test camp has pulled 24 Welsh players out of round five of the URC, with the regional internationals assembling at their Welsh base before the opening Test against Japan. Cardiff are missing seven, the Scarlets seven, the Dragons six and the Ospreys four, and RUCK says the situation is a nightmare for the head coach. Looking back at the summer squad, 14 of his 46-player extended group who play outside Wales were unavailable, a familiar frustration that is simmering again.

lead.why: The largest availability story in the pack, with 24 Welsh players affected ahead of the Japan opener, and it is new since the last edition.

teams.heading: Felipe Contepomi loses Santiago Carreras and Thomas Gallo to injury before Ireland
teams.body: Argentina go into the Ireland opener without two key men. Santiago Carreras, who has 70 Test caps, limped off on crutches in the 13th minute of Bath's 23-5 defeat to Gloucester and faces a scan on what appears to be a serious lower-limb injury. Thomas Gallo is out for at least six months after wrist surgery, while Santiago Chocobares awaits an HIA outcome, with Matías Moroni on standby.

lead.why: Two first-choice players are out and a third is in doubt, and it is new since the last edition.

teams.heading: Fin Smith's calf injury puts England's fly-half in doubt for Wallabies
teams.body: Fin Smith's fitness is the question hanging over England ahead of their Nations Championship clash with Australia. The 24-year-old damaged a calf against Leicester on Saturday and will miss England's three-day camp this week, though England remain hopeful he will be back in time. Borthwick has called up Gloucester's Charlie Atkinson as cover, and an official update is due Tuesday. Smith started all three of England's July Tests at 10.

lead.why: It is the only NEW item in the shortlist and concerns the opponent's team selection for Australia's next Test.

teams.heading: Kwagga Smith leaves Shizuoka Blue Revs by mutual agreement for Bulls
teams.body: Shizuoka Blue Revs have ended Kwagga Smith's contract by mutual agreement, opening the way for the Springbok back-rower to return to South Africa and sign a three-year deal with the Bulls. The 33-year-old spent eight seasons in Japan, the club said, and paid tribute to his leadership. Smith tore his ACL and meniscus playing for the Blue Revs in May, ruling him out for the rest of the 2026 season, and medical experts have since cleared him to return to play at the end of December.

lead.why: It is the only item in today's pack with a fresh development for a Japan-based club, and it concerns a Springbok who spent eight seasons in Japan.

teams.heading: All Blacks name Leicester Fainga'anuku in back row for Nations Championship tests
teams.body: Leicester Fainga'anuku has been named in the All Blacks back row for the Northern Hemisphere tests, one of several returnees in Dave Rennie's 36-man squad. Rennie said: "This is a really strong squad we have selected." Eight players back from injury rejoin the group, having missed various Tests earlier in 2026, and Saula Ma'u and Josh Jacomb are in the extended group and could win their maiden caps against Scotland, Wales and England.

lead.why: A new national-squad selection story, and the Savea angle has already run in the Sunday edition.

teams.heading: Cheslin Kolbe set to miss rest of Nations Championship with broken jaw
teams.body: Kolbe is set to miss the rest of the Nations Championship with a broken jaw, and the Springboks' injury list is growing. André Esterhuizen limped off after barely a minute in Cardiff, Handré Pollard came a cropper at Loftus, and concerns remain over Eben Etzebeth, Vusi Moyo and Ben-Jason Dixon. SA Rugby Magazine's Devin Hermanus argues the absences give Rassie Erasmus a chance to test new combinations before the finals weekend at the end of November.

lead.why: A new Springbok injury blow, with Kolbe's broken jaw ruling him out of the rest of the Nations Championship, is the story a fan would text about.
